description: List the current SYX components with their live weights, APYs, and total value locked. SYX is composed of 8 onchain USDC supply markets: Aave v3 (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum), Compound v3 (Ethereum), and Morpho v2 Prime USDC vaults from Steakhouse Financial and Gauntlet (Ethereum, Base). Use this when the user asks what is inside SYX, or wants to see the per-component breakdown.
name: get_syx_components
